description: Unit test class for the ModifyThing class, testing various behaviors such as immutability, JSON serialization, creation from JSON, validation of headers and permissions, size limits, and initialization scenarios related to policies and ACLs.

classes.name: ModifyThingTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ModifyThing functionality in various scenarios.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Test to verify that the ModifyThing class and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Test to verify the correctness of hashCode and equals methods for ModifyThing.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThing
methods.description: Test to ensure that passing null as the Thing parameter throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Test to verify that the toJson method produces the expected JSON output.

methods.name: toJsonWithPolicyIdToCopyReturnsExpected
methods.description: Test to verify JSON output when a policy id to copy is specified.

methods.name: toJsonWithInitialPolicyReturnsExpected
methods.description: Test to verify JSON output when an initial policy is specified.

methods.name: getEntityReturnsExpected
methods.description: Test to confirm that getEntity returns the correct JsonObject representing the thing.

methods.name: getEntityWithInitialPolicyReturnsExpected
methods.description: Test for getEntity when an initial policy is set.

methods.name: getEntityWithPolicyIdToCopyReturnsExpected
methods.description: Test for getEntity when a policy ID to copy is specified.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Test creating a ModifyThing instance from valid JSON.

methods.name: ensuresNoACLInV2Command
methods.description: Test to ensure that an ACL present in a V2 header causes an exception.

methods.name: ensuresNoPolicyInV1Command
methods.description: Test to ensure that a policy is not allowed in a V1 command.

methods.name: ensuresNoPolicyIdInV1Command
methods.description: Test to ensure that a policy ID is not allowed in a V1 command.

methods.name: modifyTooLargeThing
methods.description: Test to verify behavior when a thing exceeds size limits.

methods.name: initializeWithInitialPolicyNullAndWithCopiedPolicyNull
methods.description: Test initialization with null policies and headers.

methods.name: initializeWithCopiedPolicy
methods.description: Test initialization when copying a policy.

methods.name: initializeWithCopiedPolicyAndWithInitialPolicyNull
methods.description: Test initialization with a copied policy and no initial policy.

methods.name: initializeWithCopiedPolicyAndWithInitialPolicy
methods.description: Test initialization when both copied policy and initial policy are provided, expecting an exception.
